svg.title: Page response time (95th percentile) at each load step
svg.desc: Page response time (95th percentile) at each load step, log scale, SLO under 1 s: 50 users: 40 ms; 100 users: 22 ms; 200 users (SLO step): 22 ms; 350 users: 25 ms; 700 users (last in SLO): 207 ms; 1,050 users (knee): 2.4 s; 1,600 users (spike): 10.2 s; 200 users (recovery): 26 ms

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
